# CPU reference

`cpu_reference.txt` was captured on 12 October 2026, before extracting the
numerical stages from `src/runtime/simulation.rs` (original runtime at
`17ce85b`). It is a frozen oracle, not output regenerated by the new backend.

`tests/compute_regression.rs` defines three scenarios: local learning, frozen
learning, and learning with active intrinsic capabilities. Each includes
simultaneous signed inputs, synaptic propagation, local maintenance and a live
synapse replacement. The fixture records reports, time, pending-event count,
clock and intrinsic deadlines, all network state, post traces, homeostasis and
the complete observation log. Both default and explicitly selected CpuCompute
must reproduce it exactly.

The Rust Debug representation is a test format, not a public persistence API.
Changes to that representation require a reviewed fixture migration; changes
to numerical behavior require explicit new expectations rather than blindly
regenerating the baseline.
